title: Trident : How to Break Deep Reinforcement Learning Cyber Defenses (Agentic)
title_zh: Trident：如何攻破基于深度强化学习的自主网络防御（Agentic）
abstract_en: Autonomous cyber defense systems based on Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) have attracted significant research attention, yet remain evaluated almost exclusively against static, heuristic red agents, leaving their robustness against adaptive threats critically understudied. Meanwhile, recent advances in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) have improved LLM reasoning, but their integration into cybersecurity remains elusive due to the absence of suitable benchmark environments and interaction datasets. To bridge this gap, we introduce Trident, an agentic LLM red teaming framework comprising three components: a dynamic benchmark with isolated sandbox servers spanning CybORG CAGE 4 and CyberWheel, a dataset comprises over 13,000 high-fidelity red-blue interaction trajectories for RLVR, and a ``Code-as-Policy'' RLVR agentic architecture Trident Agentic). The latter reformulates red agent training as a contextual bandit via a tripartite Log Summarizer--Planner--Coder design, where a trainable Planner generates complete attack strategies from compressed execution logs, which a frozen Coder translates into executable Python policies deployed against live DRL defenders. Empirical evaluations reveal a fundamental brittleness in existing defenses: with a single trainable 7B planner, Trident reduces blue agent defensive performance by an average of 522% compared to static red agent baselines while autonomously discovering emergent behaviors such as decoy avoidance and adaptive state prioritization that static heuristics entirely fail to uncover.
abstract_zh: 本文指出，当前基于 Deep Reinforcement Learning（DRL）的自主网络防御系统主要在静态、启发式红队智能体上评测，因而严重低估了其面对自适应威胁时的脆弱性。为填补这一空白，作者提出 Trident，一个 agentic LLM 红队框架，包含三部分：跨 CybORG CAGE 4 与 CyberWheel 的隔离沙箱动态基准、超过 13,000 条高保真红蓝交互轨迹的 RLVR 数据集，以及采用 “Code-as-Policy” 的 Trident Agentic 架构。该架构将红队训练重构为上下文 bandit 问题，使用 Log Summarizer–Planner–Coder 三段式设计：可训练的 Planner 根据压缩后的执行日志生成完整攻击策略，冻结的 Coder 将策略转译为可执行 Python policy，并部署到真实 DRL 防御者环境中。实验显示，现有 DRL 防御存在根本性脆弱性：仅使用一个可训练的 7B Planner，Trident 相比静态红队基线使蓝队防御性能平均下降 522%，并自主发现了诱饵规避、动态状态优先级调整等静态启发式攻击无法揭示的涌现行为。
key_points_zh: 提出 Trident，一个面向自主网络防御评测的 agentic LLM 红队框架，用于测试 DRL 蓝队在自适应攻击下的鲁棒性。
构建动态基准环境，覆盖 CybORG CAGE 4 与 CyberWheel，并提供超过 13,000 条高保真红蓝交互轨迹，支持 RLVR 训练与评测。
采用 Log Summarizer–Planner–Coder 三段式 “Code-as-Policy” 架构：Planner 生成攻击策略，冻结 Coder 转换为可执行 Python policy。
实验表明，单个可训练 7B Planner 即可使蓝队防御表现相较静态红队基线平均下降 522%，暴露现有 DRL 防御的脆弱性。
Trident 能发现静态启发式红队难以触发的涌现攻击行为，包括 decoy avoidance（诱饵规避）和 adaptive state prioritization（自适应状态优先级）。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong security-oriented agent evaluation and trajectory-generation framework, especially relevant for adaptive red-team training against live defenders.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇很强的安全向智能体评估与轨迹生成工作，尤其适用于针对实时防御者的自适应红队训练。
